args.title: Update README.md to use npm start instead of npm run serve
args.body:
File: README.md

Update README.md to instruct using `npm start` instead of `npm run serve`, as `package.json` defines `start` but no `serve` script.

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

README.md instructs running `npm run serve`, but package.json has script `start` ("node dist/index.js") and no `serve` script. Update README.md to instruct using `npm start` instead of `npm run serve`.
